plain: Danish software company Systematic says it was hit by a cyberattack last week. The company says attackers reached only a test environment and that no customer systems or data were affected.

sources.name: DR: Softwarevirksomhed melder om cyberangreb, 24 Nov 2026

summary: Aarhus-based software company Systematic was hit by a cyberattack the previous week, DR reports, citing the company's LinkedIn statement. The company says its internal systems detected the attack, that attackers reached only a test environment, and that no customers' systems or data were affected. It says it reported the incident to the police, PET and the Center for Cybersikkerhed.
title: Danish software company Systematic reports cyberattack, says only a test environment was reached

validation.note: Only DR (dr.dk) read; it relays the company's own LinkedIn statement, which was not read directly.
